topic: Chef Flávia Alves transformou almoços no quintal de casa em referência da cultura afro em Paraty Mundo Negro Brasil
insights: Chef Flávia Alves has turned her home-cooked meals into a cultural reference in Paraty, Brazil, emphasizing Afro-Brazilian heritage.
Her culinary work serves as a platform to promote and celebrate Afro-Brazilian culture through food.

quotes.text: Her work promotes Afro-Brazilian culture through food.

summary: Chef Flávia Alves is recognized for her efforts in transforming traditional meals into a celebration of Afro-Brazilian culture in Paraty, Brazil. Her initiatives not only highlight the rich heritage of the Afro-Brazilian community but also serve as a cultural reference point for the region.
